usage: The phrase 影相 (jing2 soeng2) is used to describe the action of taking photos.
It is commonly placed after a subject to indicate that the subject is performing the action of taking pictures.
You can use 影相 with objects to specify what kind of photos are being taken.
It can be combined with various time phrases to describe when the photo-taking occurred.
The phrase is informal and widely used in daily conversations.
